methods.blocks: 14/28-day start-time blocks anchored at January 1; descriptive conditional window-weighted means, no population CIs
methods.contrasts: C-A and B-D paired optimizer seeds; matched ORIGINAL variance only; refits are model-specific
methods.coordinates: standardized_observation; no conversion to metres in scores or MSE
methods.endpoints: old: original selected; fresh: final 10000 primary, validation-selected secondary; selected-at-10000 aliases archived final evaluation, not the new diagnostic MC streams
methods.limits: Overlapping windows, UTC bins, MC streams and optimizer seeds are not independent environmental samples. Low-ESS IW scores are diagnostics, not true likelihood rankings. Refit is not marginal MLE, instrument noise or guaranteed calibration.
methods.metadata_limits: Selected annual case studies, not deployment effects or a random survey. Catalogue coverage does not establish unchanged hardware or stationarity. HEIGHT is pressure-equivalent recorded water-column height, not corrected sea surface or tsunami labels.
methods.references: rank16 PPCA at original matched noise and training-fitted floor1e-4; diagonal max(training variance, original noise); three shared streams, not per-model replicates or refit-matched references
methods.variance_refit: training-window posterior-expected MSE, 3x32 draws; pooled scalar; fixed learned functions
methods.variation: median and full range of three optimizer-seed stream means; MC streams reported separately

verification.neural_limit: Reviewed producer attests checkpoint replay. CPU checks saved replay components and unchanged saved means/proposals, not neural forward passes or training posterior draws.
verification.qualification_limit: Fresh prepared supports and frozen metadata checked by runner; raw acquisition and hardware history not independently reacquired here.

methods.components: Original records use selected weights and uniform test-window means; 2018 records use final weights and UTC start-hour weights. Each record's declared test target is then averaged over three Monte Carlo streams and three optimization fits. Components are not medians and do not decompose a median score. Densities use prepared standardized coordinates, residual likelihood arithmetic, float64 probabilities and float32 networks.
methods.dart_extension: Original selected DART checkpoints retain their original uniform-window target. Fresh final checkpoints use equal mass in six UTC start bins; uniform-window reductions and validation-selected endpoints are secondary. Per-record methods, independent Monte Carlo streams, optimizer-seed contrasts and fixed-function variance diagnostics are specified in dart_extension. Records with different protocols are not pooled.
methods.ecdf: Exact inclusive weighted ECDFs use each observed partition's measure and equal generated-draw mass. Mean relative to training center, population SD and lag-normalized increment norm are computed per window in meters before aggregation. Three sampling-stream CDFs are averaged within each fit; pointwise medians and full descriptive seed ranges use three fits, never pooled seeds. Fitted PPCA is one model with three streams. Feature marginals do not identify the full window distribution or dependence between level and shape.
methods.numerical: The original four canonical-control trajectories are preserved under independently pinned pre-extension producer hashes. Their complete stored states and trace closure are verified without new Gaussian training. This historical control does not attest to execution of subsequently added DART code; fresh training and diagnostics have separate source identities.
methods.replay: The exact-reproduction flag attests only the evaluator's same-process comparison with frozen importance_evaluate. Archived selected-checkpoint differences are recomputed and reported, not required to be zero across devices.
methods.spectra: Demeaned one-sided DFT bin power, not PSD, uses unchanged 192-point, 900-second window statistics and all positive bins 0.5-48 cycles/day. Stream powers are averaged linearly before seed median/range and log display. Zero power is masked only for log display, never replaced. Saved prior-decoder means are dashed, original noisy samples solid; neither is a posterior reconstruction. Scale is applied once to amplitudes and squared once to powers. Each distribution passes Parseval and within plus between equals pooled variance; median spectra need not integrate to median variance. Bins do not resolve tidal constituents.
methods.variance_refit: All three seed points show pooled v_hat / v_original and paired joint, centered and increment energy-score changes after the variance reset, in standardized coordinates. Corresponding stream differences precede stream averaging; thin ranges span those three stream differences, not confidence intervals. No new inference or independently reset same-variance comparison is performed.

numerical_validation.verification_scope: CPU verification checks exact finite NPZ states and trace closure. Common-output equality is attested by the reviewed producer's online checks, not replayed on CPU. HDF5 files are bound by SHA256 and signature only; Keras loading and HDF5 contents are not verified. Smoke attempts do not count as full trajectories. No scientific effect is estimated.
